traits.zh: 透过整面临街落地窗可见室外庭院和绿树
traits.en: Floor-to-ceiling street-facing windows open to an outdoor courtyard with green trees

traits.zh: 室内为开放式座位区，配圆形木桌和橙色座椅
traits.en: Open indoor seating area with round wooden tables and orange chairs

traits.zh: 招牌饮品为‘小马果咖’系列
traits.en: Signature drinks are the 'Xiao Ma Fruit Coffee' series

traits.zh: 使用耶加雪菲、危地马拉、哥伦比亚、云南高海拔阿拉比卡豆
traits.en: Serves Yirgacheffe, Guatemalan, Colombian, and Yunnan high-altitude Arabica beans

linger.zh: 有室内外座位与采光，适合中等时长停留
linger.en: Indoor/outdoor seating and natural light support moderate stay

energy.zh: 有顾客就座看手机，非喧闹场景
energy.en: Customers seated quietly using phones, not a loud environment
